name: Kyo
source:
Kyo Kobayashi is a skilled fighter and an indispensable part of the Time Tenshi's field team on their missions through the Time Window. She's originally from Japan, and has long, green hair with her trademark cowlick!

She enjoys playing video games - her favourite series is the fighting game "Revenge of the Revenger", and she never misses out on a preorder! She enjoys her food, too, especially senbei (rice crackers).

When she's not wielding her feather duster's concealed whip in battle (or toting her totally handy tea tray), she's often to be found in the Time Window facility's workshop, engineering all kinds of equipment for the team to use. Plus, she's highly trained in the field of medicine, so she acts as the team's nurse in case somebody suffers an injury. After all, time travel is dangerous work!

Like Rose, she not only has her Time Suit (that's the outfit you can see here), but also her facility uniform and a casual outfit for more relaxed occasions.

Kyo's a really fun, bubbly girl who brings so much personality to the Time Tenshi team!

"Tee-hee! I'm just messing with you! But if it helps you feel more comfortable, feel free to pretend that we're out on a date!"

-From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/posts/2734457]Time Tenshi Kickstarter update #4[/url]
